sources.full: LaserLlama's Alternate Blood Hunter Orders (for The Blood Hunter 2024)

subclass.name: Order of the Pale Moon
subclassFeatures: Order of the Pale Moon|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|Pale Moon|LLAltBloodHunter|3

subclass.name: Order of Salt & Iron

subclassFeatures: Order of Undying Thirst|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|Undying Thirst|LLAltBloodHunter|3

subclassFeature.name: Order of Alchemists
entries: Blood Hunters that join this Order make use of dark alchemy and transmutation magic to mutate their physical form. The power in their blood triggers massive physiological changes thanks to their experimental Mutagens. These alchemists enhance their physical form to fight monsters as their peer.
If a feature of this Order forces a saving throw, it uses the DC from your {@classFeature Hemocraft|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|1} feature (your Hemocraft save DC).

subclassFeature.name: Aberrant Alchemy
entries: Your knowledge of dark alchemy allows you to inoculate your blood with Mutagens, granting you the following benefits:

entries.name: Latent Mutagens
entries: You inoculate your bloodstream with three Mutagens of your choice from the Mutagens list below. You do not gain any benefits from these Latent Mutagens until you Mutate (see below).
During each long rest, you can spend 1 hour performing a dark procedure with {@item alchemist's supplies|XPHB} and replace one of your Latent Mutagens with another Mutagen of your choice.
Your total number of Latent Mutagens increases by two at 7th level (5), 11th level (7), and finally at 18th level (9).

entries.name: Mutate
entries: As a bonus action you can Mutate to gain the benefits of a number of Latent Mutagens equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). Your physiology radically changes to match these benefits. This effect lasts for 10 minutes, but you can end it early as a bonus action.
You can Mutate once per short or long rest at no cost, after which, you must expend a use of your Hemocraft to Mutate again.

subclassFeature.name: Monstrous Awareness
entries: The sinister power of the Mutagens in your blood also empowers your dark magic. When you make an ability check that uses alchemist's supplies, or an ability check to learn or recall information about an Aberration, Monstrosity, or Ooze, you add one roll of your hemocraft die to your ability check.

subclassFeature.name: Mutagens
entries: Below are the Mutagens available to the Order of Alchemists. If one of the Mutagens has a Blood Hunter level prerequisite, you can learn it at the same time you meet that prerequisite:

entries.name: Aberrant Sight
entries: Your eyes become pools of darkness. You gain {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to a 60-foot radius. If you already have Darkvision from your race or another feature its range increases by 60 feet. Within this radius, you can also see through magical darkness.

entries.name: Aquatic Adaptation
entries: Your neck sprouts gills or your skin becomes permeable like an amphibious creature. You gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed, and you can breathe both air and water.
If you already have a swimming speed, you can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as a bonus action while you are swimming.

entries.name: Enhanced Movement
entries: Your legs grow unnaturally thick and powerful, but become grotesque to look upon. While you are walking, you can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

entries.name: Grappling Appendage
entries: You grow an extra appendage from your back that resembles a tentacle. This appendage has a reach of 10 feet and can be used to make unarmed strikes, Shove, and Grapple. On hit, it deals bludgeoning damage equal to one roll of your hemocraft die.
It can perform simple tasks, but it cannot wield weapons or shields, nor can it manipulate objects or complex tools.
Starting at 11th level, this Mutagen grows two appendages.

entries.name: Knotted Flesh
entries: Your skin becomes hard and knotted like that of a tree or a great Beast. You can use your Constitution modifier in place of Dexterity when calculating your Armor Class in armor.
Moreover, so long as you are not wearing any armor, your Armor Class is equal to 13 + your Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Monstrous Glide
entries: You grow bat-like skin flaps that you use to glide. When you fall at least 10 feet and aren't incapacitated, you can subtract up to 100 feet from your fall when you calculate fall damage, and can move horizontally 2 feet for every 1 foot you fall.

entries.name: Oozing Form
entries: Your body can become slimy and pliable. As a bonus action, you can morph into (or revert from) an ooze-like state which allows you to squeeze through gaps as narrow as 1-inch.
Your ooze-like state has no effect on your weapons, armor, clothing, or objects, and you cannot attack while you are in it.

entries.name: Unnatural Physicality
entries: Your muscles and veins engorge with dark toxic chemicals. Whenever you make a Strength, Constitution, or Acrobatics check, you can add one roll of your hemocraft die to your roll.

entries.name: Acidic Bile
entries: {@i Prerequisite: 7th-level Blood Hunter}

You can spew corrosive acid from your mouth. You know the {@spell acid splash|XPHB} cantrip, Intelligence is its spellcasting ability, and when you deal damage with it you add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1) to the damage roll.

entries.name: Corrosive Blood
entries: {@i Prerequisite: 7th-level Blood Hunter}

Your wounds expel a corrosive acid. When a creature you can see within 15 feet of you hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to cause the attacker to take acid damage equal to one roll of your hemocraft die + your Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Dislocated Reach
entries: {@i Prerequisite: 7th-level Blood Hunter}
Strange experiments allow your joints to unnaturally stretch, crack, and expand. The length of your arms doubles, and the reach of your melee attacks increases by 5 feet.

entries.name: Engorged Physique
entries: {@i Prerequisite: 7th-level Blood Hunter}

Chemicals forcefully enlarge your body, giving you a hideous physique. You grow by one size (for example, from Medium to Large). If there is not room for you to grow in size, you grow to the maximum size allowed by your current surroundings.
While engorged, your reach increases by 5 feet, your weight is multiplied by eight, and all your melee weapon attacks deal bonus damage equal to one roll of your hemocraft die on hit.

entries.name: Inoculated Vigor
entries: {@i Prerequisite: 7th-level Blood Hunter}
You inoculate yourself against all but the worst poisons. You gain Immunity to both acid and poison damage, and you gain Immunity to all disease and to the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Toxic Symbiosis
entries: {@i Prerequisite: 7th-level Blood Hunter}

When you hit a creature that is not a Construct or Undead with a melee attack, you can use your bonus action on that turn to siphon life force from its wound. You then gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).

entries.name: Viscous Grip
entries: {@i Prerequisite: 7th-level Blood Hunter}
Your hands and feet secrete a sticky substance. You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, and you can climb difficult surfaces without needing to make an ability check.
Also, creatures have disadvantage on ability checks or saving throws they make to escape being {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by you.

entries.name: Accelerated Physiology
entries: {@i Prerequisite: 11th-level Blood Hunter}
Strange chemicals enhance your physical ability and radically increase your aggression. When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can make one additional attack.
However, if you end your turn and haven't attacked another creature since the end of your previous turn, you immediately take necrotic damage equal to one roll of your hemocraft die.

entries.name: Alchemical Intellect
entries: {@i Prerequisite: 11th-level Blood Hunter}

Dark rites have enhanced your mind at the expense of your body. You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws, but you have disadvantage on all Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws.

entries.name: Hideous Regeneration
entries: {@i Prerequisite: 11th-level Blood Hunter}
If you begin your turn with less than half of your hit points, but at least 1 hit point, you instantly regain hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).

entries.name: Monstrous Flight
entries: {@i Prerequisite: 11th-level Blood Hunter}
A pair of monstrous leathery wings sprout forth from your back. You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed.

entries.name: Synthetic Carapace
entries: {@i Prerequisite: 11th-level Blood Hunter}

Your skin hardens resembling that of a terrible insectoid creature. You gain a +2 bonus to your Armor Class, and you gain resistance to all bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from non-magical and non-silvered attacks.

entries.name: Alchemists & Experimentation
entries: The Mutagens included here are the most common examples created by Alchemist Blood Hunters. Talk to your DM about crafting custom Mutagens based on abilities from monsters that you slay or study!

subclassFeature.name: Enduring Mutation
entries: The potency of your dark alchemical experiments has grown. During a long rest, you can spend 1 hour using alchemist's supplies to make the effects of a single Latent Mutagen permanent, even when you aren't Mutated. When you Mutate, this Enduring Mutagen always counts as one of the Latent Mutagens that you gain the benefits of.
You can replace this Enduring Mutagen with another one of your Latent Mutagens during a subsequent long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Noxious Strike
entries: You can weaponize the strange toxins in your blood to afflict your enemies. Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes acid damage equal to four rolls of your hemocraft die and is {@condition Blinded|XPHB} or {@condition Stunned|XPHB} for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half damage and suffers no other effects.
A Blinded or Stunned creature repeats this saving throw each time it takes damage, ending this effect on a success.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. When you have no uses left you can expend a use of your Hemocraft to use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Rapid Mutation
entries: You have gained mastery over your body's mutability. While you are Mutated, you can use a bonus action to switch one of your active Mutagens for one of your Latent Mutagens.

subclassFeature.name: Order of Heretics
entries: Excommunicated from their religious orders, the founders of the Order of Heretics were holy priests who desired to utilize forbidden rites to combat darkness. Branded heretics, these conduits of divine power supplemented their holy knowledge with blood magic. Now, this Order of priestly Blood Hunters works to combat wayward divine entities, both good and evil.
If a feature of this Order forces a saving throw, it uses the DC from your {@classFeature Hemocraft|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|1} feature (your Hemocraft save DC).

subclassFeature.name: Blasphemous Prayer
entries: You are able to channel divine energies despite your status as a heretic. You gain two Channel Divinity options: Censure the Divine, which is detailed below, and one Channel Divinity of your choice from those available to {@class Cleric} Divine Domains at 2nd level. For the second, you use your Blood Hunter level in place of Cleric level and your Hemocraft save DC. You can only use one Channel Divinity option per turn.

You can use each of your Channel Divinities once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you have no uses left, you can expend a use of your Hemocraft to use a Channel Divinity option you know again.

entries.name: Censure the Divine
entries: As an action, you utter blasphemies painful to divine entities. Celestials, Fiends, or other creatures capable of divine magic (such as Clerics or Paladins) of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be {@condition Restrained|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} for 1 minute.
Creatures repeat this saving throw at the end of their turns, and when they take damage, ending this effect on a success.

subclassFeature.name: Heretical Knowledge
entries: Despite your beliefs, you understand the traditional religious practices, rites, and prayers. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in {@skill Religion|XPHB}. If already proficient, you add double your proficiency bonus to all Religion checks.
You learn two cantrips of your choice from the {@filter Cleric spell list|spells|level=0|class=Cleric}. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for them.
When you make an ability check to learn or recall information about a Celestial, Fiend, or Undead, you can add one roll of your hemocraft die to your ability check.

subclassFeature.name: Unholy Restoration
entries: You can draw life from one creature and transfer it to another in a dark mockery of divine magic. As an action, you can force a creature you can see within 30 feet to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes necrotic damage equal to four rolls of your hemocraft die, or half as much damage on a success. It has disadvantage on its saving throw if you touch it.
Another creature of your choice you can see within 30 feet regains hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all uses when you finish a long rest. When you have no uses left, you can expend a use of your Hemocraft to use this feature again.

subclassFeature.name: Divine Anathema
entries: When you use Censure the Divine you can expend a use of your Hemocraft to empower it, forgoing its normal effects to instead force creatures of your choice within 30 feet to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, their speed is reduced by 10 feet.

Creatures suffering from this effect must repeat this saving throw at the end of each of their turns. On a failed save, their speed is reduced by an additional 10 feet. On a success, they regain 10 feet of their speed.
This effect ends when a creature's speed returns to normal, or when the speed reduction from this feature equals its total speed, at which point the creature is instantly {@condition Petrified|XPHB}.
Celestials and Fiends have disadvantage on saving throws to resist this feature. Once a creature succeeds against this feature it is immune to its effect until the following dawn.

subclassFeature.name: Utmost Transgression
entries: You use your occult knowledge to bind denizens of heaven to your will. As an action, you can cast the {@spell conjure celestial|PHB} spell, at 5th-level. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.
The Celestial is bound against its will by blasphemous blood magic, allowing you to ignore the material component of the spell, but its duration is reduced to 1 minute.

You can cast this spell between each short or long rest at no cost, after which, you must expend a number of uses of your Hemocraft equal to the CR of the Celestial you wish to conjure to cast it again.

subclassFeature.name: Order of the Pale Moon
entries: Lycanthropy is an ancient curse that changes those afflicted into mindless Beasts with an unquenchable hunger for flesh. In order to combat these monsters, some Blood Hunters will purposefully contract this curse. These warriors willingly give their lives so that they may draw on this bestial power to rid the world of lycanthropes and other shapeshifting monsters.
If a feature of this Order forces a saving throw, it uses the DC from your {@classFeature Hemocraft|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|1} feature (your Hemocraft save DC).

subclassFeature.name: Feral Senses
entries: Your lycanthropy heightens your senses. Whenever you make a Perception or Survival check based on your sense of sight, hearing, or smell, you add one roll of your hemocraft die to your roll.
In addition, when you make an ability check to learn or recall information about a Beast, Monstrosity, or Shapeshifter, add one roll of your hemocraft die to your roll.

subclassFeature.name: Lycanthropic Curse
entries: You have been infected with a curse based on a Beast of CR 1 or lower. Once chosen, this Beast cannot be changed.

As a bonus action, you can Shift, transforming into a Beast Form or Hybrid Form, both of which are detailed below. You can Shift once per short or long rest at no cost, after which, you must expend a use of your Hemocraft to Shift again.

You can remain Shifted for up to 1 hour, but it ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} or if you end it as a bonus action. You can expend a use of your Hemocraft to extend the duration by 1 hour.

entries.name: Beast Form
entries: You take on the form of the Beast your curse is based upon:

entries.name: Statistics
entries: When you Shift, your statistics are replaced by those of your Beast, but you retain your hit points, alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You retain your skill and saving throw proficiencies, and gain the Beast's. If you share a proficiency, use the higher bonus.

entries.name: Cursed Form
entries: Your Beast Form's natural weapons use your hemocraft die as their damage die and your Hemocraft save DC for any saving throws, unless their innate bonuses are higher.

entries.name: Equipment
entries: When you Shift, you choose if your equipment merges with your Beast Form or if it falls to the ground. You can only merge with equipment that you can wear or carry.

entries.name: Features
entries: Your Beast Form retains all features from your class, race, and other sources, including the ability to invoke blood curses. It can use all these features as long as the Beast would also be physically capable of doing so.
However, you do not retain special Senses, such as Darkvision, unless your Beast Form also has that same special Sense.

entries.name: Hybrid Form
entries: You become a fusion of yourself and the Beast of your curse. You retain your normal statistics but gain certain benefits:

entries.name: Bestial Physiology
entries: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet and you gain a climb speed equal to your walking speed.

entries.name: Savage Strikes
entries: You grow terrifying fangs and claws. Your unarmed strikes gain the Finesse property. On hit, they deal piercing or slashing damage equal to one roll of your hemocraft die.

entries.name: Wild Fury
entries: You can use your bonus action on each turn to make an unarmed strike or take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action. Should you Dash, you must move toward a Hostile creature you can see.

subclassFeature.name: Lycan Warrior
entries: You are able to draw out more power from your curse. While Shifted, your attacks are magical, and you gain Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from attacks that are non-magical and non-silvered.

When Shifted, you can activate a {@classFeature Crimson Rite|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|2} on your transformation, applying its benefits to all your natural weapons and unarmed strikes. If you are holding a weapon with an active Crimson Rite when you Shift, you can transfer that rite to your natural weapons and unarmed strikes.

subclassFeature.name: Feral Prowess
entries: Your curse allows you to shrug off minor wounds. When you begin your turn Shifted, and you have less than half your hit points remaining, but at least 1 hit point, you regain hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (a minimum of 1).

subclassFeature.name: Lycanthropic Mastery
entries: You have mastered your lycanthropic curse. You can Shift at will without expending a use of your Hemocraft, and you can remain in your Shifted forms indefinitely.

Finally, while Shifted, you have advantage on attack rolls against the creature branded by your {@classFeature Brand of Castigation|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|6}, and you have advantage on any saving throws it forces you to make.

subclassFeature.name: Order of Salt & Iron
entries: Since the dawn of time, the ancient Order of Salt & Iron has trained exorcists to defend the living from the undead. Willing to sacrifice all that they are, these Blood Hunters stain their souls with spectral power. They then use the power of darkness to drive back the darkness itself, and work tirelessly to prevent the tide of undeath from overwhelming the living.
If a feature of this Order forces a saving throw, it uses the DC from your {@classFeature Hemocraft|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|1} feature (your Hemocraft save DC).

entries.subclassFeature: Warrior of the Dawn|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|Salt & Iron|LLAltBloodHunter|3

entries.name: Exorcists, Clerics, & Gods
entries: Traditions within the Order of Salt & Iron claim the founding of their Order predates gods themselves. Exorcists claim to have stood against the tide of undeath long before the first Clerics and Paladins.

subclassFeature.name: Spectral Nature
entries: You have tainted your soul with ghastly power. You require half the amount of sleep, food, and drink for the average member of your race.

Also, you can use a bonus action to enter a temporary Spectral State, which lasts until the end of your current turn. While in this state, you are resistant to all bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from non-magical and non-silvered attacks, and you can move through solid objects and creatures as if they were difficult terrain. If you end your movement inside a creature or object, you are instantly shunted to the nearest unoccupied space, taking {@damage 1d10} force damage for every 5 feet you were shunted.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all uses when you finish a long rest. You can expend a use of your Hemocraft to use this feature again.
At certain levels in this class, the duration of this Spectral State increases: at 7th level (1 minute), 11th level (1 hour), and at 18th level (indefinite). You can end this state as a bonus action.

subclassFeature.name: Warrior of the Dawn
entries: Your blood magic is especially potent when used against the undead. When you make an ability check to learn or recall information about Undead, you add one roll of your hemocraft die to your ability check.

Also, when you activate a {@classFeature Crimson Rite|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|2}, you can choose to empower it with the signature magicks of your Order, granting you the following additional benefits:

items: The extra damage of your Crimson Rite is radiant.
You gain resistance to necrotic damage.
The weapon sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius.

subclassFeature.name: Curse Specialist
entries: Your knowledge and experience with undead enhances the power of your blood magic. You can target any creature with your {@filter blood curse|optionalfeatures|Feature Type=Blood Curse}s, even if it does not have blood in its veins.

In addition, at the end of each long rest you can choose one blood curse you know. You can invoke that blood curse once without expending a use of your Hemocraft before you finish your next long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Warrior Exorcist
entries: You use the power of blood magic to drive out the influence of extraplanar creatures. As a bonus action on your turn, you can choose one willing creature within 30 feet that can hear you that is {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, or magically controlled, and instantly end one of the above effects on it.

If the creature that inflicted this condition is also within 30 feet, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it takes radiant damage equal to four rolls of your hemocraft die, and half damage on a success.
You can use this feature once per short or long rest at no cost, after which, you must expend a use of your Hemocraft to use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Sacrificial Offering
entries: You can sacrifice your own vitality to resist the grasp of death. When you would fall to 0 hit points but are not killed outright, you can expend a use of your Hemocraft and reduce your hit point maximum by one roll of your hemocraft die until you finish a long rest, falling to 1 hit point instead.

subclassFeature.name: Spectral Mastery
entries: You walk between the land of the living and the dead. For every 10 years that pass, you age 1 year, and you no longer need to sleep, eat, or drink. You gain the benefits of a long rest when you spend 6 hours performing only light activity.
Moreover, when you are in your Spectral State, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover.

subclassFeature.name: Order of Undying Thirst
entries: Legends speak of an ancient vampire who came to regret the many atrocities he had committed when driven by his thirst. He gathered to himself a group of vampire hunters, and once they had vowed to scour the curse of vampirism from the world, passed his curse on to them and instructed them in the power of ancient blood magic. Known as the Order of Undying Thirst, these Blood Hunters relentlessly carry out their founding vow to exterminate all vampires.
If a feature of this Order forces a saving throw, it uses the DC from your {@classFeature Hemocraft|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|1} feature (your Hemocraft save DC).

entries.name: Optional Rule: True Vampirism
entries: True vampiric power comes at significant cost. If you'd like to play as a true vampire, you gain ALL abilities below when you join this Order:

entries.name: Deathless Nature
entries: You don't need to breathe.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed. Upon reaching 7th level, you can move across vertical surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

entries.name: Superior Darkvision
entries: You have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, you can only see shades of gray.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in direct sunlight you have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. If you already have the Sunlight Sensitivity trait from another source then you gain Vulnerability to radiant damage.

subclassFeature.name: Blood Magic Specialist
entries: Your curse grants you increased control over your blood magic. You learn one additional {@filter blood curse|optionalfeatures|Feature Type=Blood Curse}, which doesn't count against the number of blood curses you know.

Also, your affinity for blood magic increases the size of your hemocraft die by one step, to a d8. At certain Blood Hunter levels, your hemocraft die increases again: at 5th level it becomes a d10, and at 11th level a d12.
Finally, whenever you activate a {@classFeature Crimson Rite|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|2}, you can choose for its extra damage to be necrotic damage.

subclassFeature.name: Vampiric Nature
entries: The ancient disease of your Order has irreparably changed your physiology. Your teeth become Fangs which you can use for unarmed strikes. On hit, your Fangs deal necrotic damage equal to one roll of your hemocraft die + your Strength modifier.
Moreover, whenever you make an ability check to learn or recall information about an Undead creature, you add one roll of your hemocraft die to your ability check.

subclassFeature.name: Essence Drain
entries: You can drain the life from your foes. When you hit a creature with an attack, you can use your bonus action to make a Fang attack against that creature. On hit, you regain hit points equal to the damage dealt.
You can regain hit points in this way a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once), and you regain all uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Sinister Resilience
entries: The life you steal from others invigorates you. Whenever you deal necrotic damage to a creature, you can gain temporary hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.
While these temporary hit points last, you are resistant to necrotic, poison, and all bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from all non-magical and non-silvered attacks.
However, if you take radiant damage, all of your temporary hit points from this feature are immediately dispelled, and the total radiant damage is applied to your normal hit points.

subclassFeature.name: Misty Escape
entries: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to turn into a cloud of swirling mist, and the triggering attack automatically misses. You instantly reappear in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet.
Once you use this reaction you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again. When you have no uses left, you can expend a use of your Hemocraft to use this reaction again.

subclassFeature.name: Crimson Lord
entries: You have mastered your ancient curse, and your abilities rival those of true vampire lords. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed.
When you damage a creature with a Fang attack, it has disadvantage on its saving throws to resist the effects of your blood curses until the end of your next turn.
For every 10 years that pass, your body only ages 1 year.

subclassFeature.name: Order of Witch Knights
entries: Blood Hunters who join the dark Order of Witch Knights are driven by an overwhelming desire to destroy the great evils of the world. Those especially dedicated, those willing to give up anything, are often approached by Eldritch Powers, beings of otherworldly might. These benefactors offer power in return for a fraction of the warrior's soul or unquestioning fealty.
If a feature of this Order forces a saving throw, it uses the DC from your {@classFeature Hemocraft|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|1} feature (your Hemocraft save DC).

entries.subclassFeature: Witch Knight Spell List|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|Witch Knights|LLAltBloodHunter|3

entries.name: Witch Knights & Warlocks
entries: If you have levels in both Warlock and the Order of Witch Knights, you determine your available Pact Magic spell slots by adding together your Warlock levels and one-third of your Blood Hunter levels (rounded down). Then, use this total to determine your spell slots by consulting the Warlock table.

subclassFeature.name: Pact Magic
entries: The bargain you have struck with your Patron has granted you the ability to cast spells, much like a {@class Warlock|XPHB} does:

entries.name: Cantrips
entries: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Witch Knight spell list. Upon reaching 11th level in this class you learn one additional Witch Knight cantrip of your choice.

entries.name: Spell Slots
entries: The Witch Knight Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have, and the level of those spell slots. All of your spell slots from this feature are the same level. To cast one of your Witch Knight spells of 1st level or higher, you must expend a spell slot. You regain all of your expended spell slots when you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher
entries: You learn two 1st-level spells of your choice from the Witch Knight spell list. The Spells Known column of the Witch Knight Spellcasting table shows when you learn more Witch Knight spells of 1st level or higher. Spells you choose must be of a level no higher than the level in the table's Slot Level column for your level.
Whenever you gain a Blood Hunter level, you can choose one Witch Knight spell you know and replace it with another Witch Knight spell of a level for which you have spell slots.

entries.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: As your magic is powered by sinister blood ritual, Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for Witch Knight spells. You use your Intelligence to calculate the spell save DC and spell attack modifier for all Witch Knight spells:

subclassFeature.name: Crimson Blade
entries: Sinister blood magic empowers your weapons. You can use a weapon with an active {@classFeature Crimson Rite|Blood Hunter|BloodHunter2024|2} as the spellcasting focus for your Witch Knight spells.

Also, whenever you expend a Pact Magic spell slot, you can empower one weapon you are holding. The weapon gains a Crimson Rite you know without you losing hit points, or, if it already has an active Crimson Rite, its next attack deals extra damage equal to one roll of your hemocraft die per level of the Pact Magic spell slot.

subclassFeature.name: Sanguine Warrior
entries: You seamlessly weave minor spells with weapon attacks. If you use your action to Cast a Spell, or activate a spell you are concentrating on (such as {@spell witch bolt|XPHB}), you can make a single weapon attack as a bonus action on that turn.
When using a weapon with an active Crimson Rite as a spellcasting focus, you can change the damage dealt by any spell you cast to match the damage type of that weapon's Crimson Rite.

subclassFeature.name: Bewitched Strikes
entries: The cursed magic in your blood seeps into your weapons. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a blood curse or spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Profane Sacrifice
entries: You can offer the death of your foes to your Eldritch Power for enhanced magicks. If a hostile creature dies within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to regain one Pact Magic spell slot, or gain temporary hit points equal to one roll of your hemocraft die + your Blood Hunter level.
Once you use this feature you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.
